caption:
From bare framing to a spa-like bathroom. 🛁 We reframed this whole bathroom in Reading, Ohio, then wrapped it in large gray tile, floor to ceiling.

A walk-in shower with a tiled half wall and glass, a mosaic floor, a rain head and a built-in niche, with the window tiled right in.

Urban Stone Collective does full bathroom remodels and custom tile work, start to finish, not just countertops.
